data.one_liner: Interactive Dart REPL with hot reload and full grammar support
data.what_it_does: Provides a command‑line REPL for Dart that lets you import packages, define code, and hot‑reload changes while preserving state. It evaluates expressions, statements, functions, and classes in an isolated workspace.
use_when: You need a quick interactive shell for Dart debugging or experimentation
You want to test code snippets without creating a full project
You want to experiment with third‑party packages on the fly
avoid_when: You are building a production app that requires a stable runtime
You need a library to be imported into other Dart code
strengths: Hot reload preserves state across edits
Easy addition of third‑party packages via !dart pub add
Works on all platforms supported by Dart
weaknesses: Not a library, only a CLI tool
No IDE integration out of the box
data.setup_notes: Run `dart install interactive` or `dart run interactive@`
